job.title: [Post] Kalyan Raavi (He/Him/His)
job.email_subject: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – SAP Certified, 5+ years
job.email_body:
Dear Kalyan Raavi,

I saw your post about SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris hiring – I have built and extended exactly these platforms for more than five years, as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

– 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 / 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell
– OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third parties
– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration

I take ownership from requirement to production and work smoothly with international teams and business stakeholders. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs for headless storefronts, Promotions Engine, OMS, Impex, Cronjobs and FlexibleSearch, plus PIM / ERP / MDM integrations with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performs code reviews, mentors junior developers and supports production in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Your post targets SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris specialists, which is precisely my core: five years of building B2B and B2C commerce on Hybris 2105 and 2211 for Rockwell Automation and Shell, from OCC APIs to PIM and ERP integration. I want to bring that hands-on depth to a team that values platform expertise and clean delivery.

en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
en.hook: You are hiring for SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris – and that is exactly the platform I have built on for more than five years. At Rockwell Automation and Shell I develop and extend enterprise B2B and B2C platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) with Java and Spring, as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: PIM / ERP integration
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: CCv2 delivery & performance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and supported production troubleshooting.

en.logistics: I take ownership from requirement to production and work smoothly with international teams and business stakeholders. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
